items.text: The November Core Update is still rolling out, and SERP trackers lost up to 98% of their data on Nov. 18. Judge ranking drops in GSC before you report them.
Google Search Profiles are now live worldwide and can show LinkedIn and Threads accounts. Claim and complete profiles for client authors and experts.
AI citations change with each model update. One ChatGPT update brought 51% more cited URLs per prompt, so report citation trends over weeks, not single checks.
Analytics miss most AI-driven visits. Customers name AI chatbots more than half the time when asked how they found a business, so add a 'How did you hear about us?' field to client forms.
AI answers now show ads, shopping results and coupon codes. Check how e-commerce clients show up for product and coupon prompts.
Ask Maps can now call local businesses to check hours and prices. Check the GBP call setting for each local client and brief their staff.
